basis: StageA complete development native30 replies plus historical C2-016 boundary requirement; not prospective model outputs
scope: Bounded Chinese explicit assistant self/joint physical offers or experiences. No general semantic verifier, no preference ownership or implicit coreference approval.
candidate: Explicit我/我们 and actual physical action patterns; preserve writing/fiction/role, quoted content, negation/hypothesis, online planning and third-person advice. Ambiguous offers without explicit subject and implicit desire remain unchanged and unresolved.
frames: Derive composition/fiction/role from current privacy-valid application context, not test case IDs. Analytic frame labels are expected context fixtures; real HTTP must derive them.
stream: Candidate buffers native reply until review, never emits raw intercepted statements; final metadata separates bounded correction from llm native and generic verifier remainsFalse.

gate.analytic: 12 positive must change with rule/span evidence;20 negatives preserve bytes exactly
gate.prospective: Only after source freeze run preregistered12 prospective scenes, paired baseline/candidate in alternating order on both pinned models, actual application HTTP/SSE; preserve every raw response and final bytes, flags and failure. No service fallback accepted as quality pass.
gate.regression: No quote/literal loss or unauthorized side effect; cancellation/privacy and existing stream guards hold
gate.activation: No automatic production default activation from analytic or lexical/model self-score. Record bounded evidence, unresolved ambiguity and agent-vs-human review separately.
